description: This file implements a WebSocketInflater class for decompressing WebSocket data streams using zlib, including buffer management and inflate operations.

classes.name: ShrinkableIOBufferWithSize
classes.description: A subclass of IOBufferWithSize that allows shrinking the buffer size.

classes.name: WebSocketInflater
classes.description: Main class for inflating WebSocket data streams, managing input/output buffers, and decompression state.

classes.name: WebSocketInflater::OutputBuffer
classes.description: Manages the output buffer for decompressed data, supporting read and buffer management.

classes.name: WebSocketInflater::InputQueue
classes.description: Manages the input data queue for inflating, supporting push and consume operations.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the inflater with a specified window bits parameter.

methods.name: AddBytes
methods.description: Adds data bytes to the inflater for decompression.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Signals the end of input data for the inflater.

methods.name: GetOutput
methods.description: Retrieves decompressed output data of specified size.

methods.name: InflateWithFlush
methods.description: Performs inflation with flushing, handling partial data.

methods.name: Inflate
methods.description: Performs the inflation process on input data with specified flush mode.

methods.name: InflateChokedInput
methods.description: Inflates data from the input queue when input is choked.

methods.name: OutputBuffer::Size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the output buffer.

methods.name: OutputBuffer::GetTail
methods.description: Returns a pointer and size to the tail of the output buffer for writing.

methods.name: OutputBuffer::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the output buffer into a destination buffer.

methods.name: OutputBuffer::AdvanceHead
methods.description: Advances the head pointer of the output buffer after reading.

methods.name: OutputBuffer::AdvanceTail
methods.description: Advances the tail pointer of the output buffer after writing.

methods.name: InputQueue::Top
methods.description: Returns the top buffer and size for inflating.

methods.name: InputQueue::Push
methods.description: Pushes data into the input queue.

methods.name: InputQueue::Consume
methods.description: Consumes data from the input queue after inflating.

methods.name: PushToLastBuffer
methods.description: Copies data into the last buffer of the input queue.
